sources.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now

cards.summary: As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude's code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was announced in March and became generally available in October .

sources.title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film

cards.summary: Though David Fincher 's fans had been eagerly anticipating The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth , early screenings of the Once Upon a Time in Hollywood sequel starring Brad Pitt have raised questions about whether generative AI was used in the film. People have claimed that the movie is chock-full of uncanny, inconsistent visuals that make it feel more like slop than the sort of polished film you'd expect from the director of sleek productions like Fight Club and The Social Network .

sources.title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month

cards.summary: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen .
